title: Simple Joindate
description: Lightweight /joindate plugin made for anarchy or SMP servers
body:
**Simple Joindate** is a simple and lightweight plugin inspired by 9b9t's /jd that allows players to see their or someone else joindate. It doesn't require any setup and it's easy to use.

Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21.11 and Java 21+

## Commands
By default, everyone has access to **/joindate** and **/jd**

**simplejd.main** - Access to **/simplejd** and **/simplejd** reload
- **/joindate** (/**jd**) - Shows your or someone else joindate.
- **/simplejd** - Main command.
- **/simplejd** reload - Reloads the plugin.
